title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in models. It adds a penalty to the loss function to discourage complex models. Can you think of how this might affect the bias and variance of the model?

title: L1 Regularization and Bias
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to shrink some coefficients to zero, effectively selecting a simpler model. How might this simplification impact the model's bias?

title: Effect of L1 Regularization
text: Which of the following statements is true about L1 regularization?
choices: L1 regularization has no effect on model bias
